story.hu: Rubik Ernő fiatal tanár és építész.
story.en: Ernő Rubik is a young teacher and architect.
story.ro: Ernő Rubik este un tânăr profesor și arhitect.

story.hu: A diákjainak egy játékot készít: egy kicsi, színes kockát.
story.en: He makes a toy for his students: a small, colourful cube.
story.ro: Le face studenților o jucărie: un cub mic și colorat.

story.hu: A kockának hat oldala és hat színe van.
story.en: The cube has six sides and six colours.
story.ro: Cubul are șase fețe și șase culori.

story.hu: Rubik Ernő forgatja, és a színek összekeverednek.
story.en: Rubik turns it, and the colours get mixed up.
story.ro: Rubik îl rotește, iar culorile se amestecă.

story.hu: Egy hónapig tart, amíg újra kirakja!
story.en: It takes him a month to solve it again!
story.ro: Îi ia o lună până îl rezolvă din nou!

story.hu: Ma a világon mindenki ismeri a Rubik-kockát.
story.en: Today everyone in the world knows the Rubik's Cube.
story.ro: Azi toată lumea cunoaște cubul Rubik.

facts.hu: A budapesti M1-es metró 1896 óta jár.
facts.en: Budapest's M1 metro has run since 1896: the oldest underground railway on the European continent.
facts.ro: Metroul M1 din Budapesta circulă din 1896: cel mai vechi metrou de pe continentul european.

facts.hu: A golyóstollat Bíró László találja fel.
facts.en: The ballpoint pen was invented by László Bíró from Budapest; in Britain it's still called a "biro".
facts.ro: Pixul a fost inventat de budapestanul László Bíró; în Marea Britanie i se spune și azi „biro”.

facts.en: The Gömböc, designed in Budapest in 2006, is a shape that always rolls back upright by itself.
facts.ro: Gömböc, creat la Budapesta în 2006, este o formă care se ridică mereu singură.

facts.en: John G. Kemény, born in Budapest, co-created the BASIC programming language.
facts.ro: John G. Kemény, născut la Budapesta, a creat împreună cu un coleg limbajul de programare BASIC.

words.en: to solve (a puzzle), to lay out

questions.qEn: How many colours does the cube have?
Who knows the Rubik's Cube today?
